entities.summary: Sallie L. Krawcheck is an American business executive who is the founder and former CEO of Ellevest, an investing platform for women launched in 2016. She was previously head of Bank of America's Global Wealth and Investment Management division. She has been called "the most powerful woman on Wall Street."
